_comment: THE DESCENT ITSELF, as opposed to any one floor in it. What a KIND of space is made of lives in config/rooms/*.json, one file per type, and a hole names which type it opens (see config/holes/*.json). This file holds only what is true of the whole dig. default: the type a floor takes when nothing named one -- the house's own foundation. descent.act_every is where the delta NARROWS: every nth depth is one floor that every branch DESCENDING into it leads to, so the descent converges on its root instead of widening forever. 0 turns convergence off. Rooms reached sideways sit at that depth without being an arrival into the act, and never rejoin.
